import os, requests

BASE = os.environ["PIX_BASE_URL"]          # ex.: https://api.seupsp.com.br/pix/v2 (cada PSP tem a sua)
CERT = (os.environ["PIX_CERT_PEM"], os.environ["PIX_KEY_PEM"])   # mTLS obrigatorio

def token(escopo: str) -> str:
    r = requests.post(
        os.environ["PIX_TOKEN_URL"],
        data={"grant_type": "client_credentials", "scope": escopo},
        auth=(os.environ["PIX_CLIENT_ID"], os.environ["PIX_CLIENT_SECRET"]),
        cert=CERT, timeout=30,
    )
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r.json()["access_token"]

def erro(r):
    p = r.json() if "json" in r.headers.get("content-type", "") else {}
    viol = "; ".join(f'{v.get("propriedade")}: {v.get("razao")}' for v in p.get("violacoes", []))
    raise RuntimeError(f'{r.status_code} {p.get("type", "")} {p.get("detail", r.text[:200])} {viol}')

txid = "pedido2026081200000000000042"   # 26 a 35 alfanumericos, derivado do seu pedido
corpo = {
    "calendario": {"expiracao": 3600},
    "devedor": {"cnpj": "00000000000191", "nome": "Comercio Exemplo Ltda"},
    "valor": {"original": "149.90"},          # string, duas casas
    "chave": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000",
    "solicitacaoPagador": "Pedido 4210",
}
r = requests.put(f"{BASE}/cob/{txid}", json=corpo, cert=CERT,
                 headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token('cob.write')}"}, timeout=30)
if r.status_code not in (200, 201):
    erro(r)
cob = r.json()
print(cob["txid"], cob["status"], cob["pixCopiaECola"])

        os.environ["PIX_TOKEN_URL"],

    tk, pagina, itens = token("cobv.read"), 0, []

        itens += d.get("cobs", [])
        pagina += 1
        if pagina >= d["parametros"]["paginacao"]["quantidadeDePaginas"]:
            return itens

import os, requests

BASE = os.environ["PIX_BASE_URL"]          # ex.: https://api.seupsp.com.br/pix/v2 (cada PSP tem a sua)
CERT = (os.environ["PIX_CERT_PEM"], os.environ["PIX_KEY_PEM"])   # mTLS obrigatorio

def token(escopo: str) -> str:
    r = requests.post(
        os.environ["PIX_TOKEN_URL"],
        data={"grant_type": "client_credentials", "scope": escopo},
        auth=(os.environ["PIX_CLIENT_ID"], os.environ["PIX_CLIENT_SECRET"]),
        cert=CERT, timeout=30,
    )
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r.json()["access_token"]

def erro(r):
    p = r.json() if "json" in r.headers.get("content-type", "") else {}
    viol = "; ".join(f'{v.get("propriedade")}: {v.get("razao")}' for v in p.get("violacoes", []))
    raise RuntimeError(f'{r.status_code} {p.get("type", "")} {p.get("detail", r.text[:200])} {viol}')

r = requests.get(f"{BASE}/lotecobv/carne-2026-08-vespertino", cert=CERT,
                 headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token('lotecobv.read')}"}, timeout=60)
if r.status_code != 200:
    erro(r)
lote = r.json()
negadas = [c for c in lote["cobsv"] if c["status"] == "NEGADA"]
for c in negadas:
    prob = c.get("problema", {})
    print(c["txid"], prob.get("detail"),
          [v["propriedade"] for v in prob.get("violacoes", [])])
print(f'{len(lote["cobsv"]) - len(negadas)} criadas, {len(negadas)} negadas')

import os, requests

BASE = os.environ["PIX_BASE_URL"]          # ex.: https://api.seupsp.com.br/pix/v2 (cada PSP tem a sua)
CERT = (os.environ["PIX_CERT_PEM"], os.environ["PIX_KEY_PEM"])   # mTLS obrigatorio

def token(escopo: str) -> str:
    r = requests.post(
        os.environ["PIX_TOKEN_URL"],
        data={"grant_type": "client_credentials", "scope": escopo},
        auth=(os.environ["PIX_CLIENT_ID"], os.environ["PIX_CLIENT_SECRET"]),
        cert=CERT, timeout=30,
    )
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r.json()["access_token"]

def erro(r):
    p = r.json() if "json" in r.headers.get("content-type", "") else {}
    viol = "; ".join(f'{v.get("propriedade")}: {v.get("razao")}' for v in p.get("violacoes", []))
    raise RuntimeError(f'{r.status_code} {p.get("type", "")} {p.get("detail", r.text[:200])} {viol}')

e2eid = "E00000000202608121402abcdef123456"
dev_id = "dev4210001"        # id seu: repetir o mesmo id nao devolve duas vezes

# 1) confira quanto ja foi devolvido antes de pedir
r = requests.get(f"{BASE}/pix/{e2eid}", cert=CERT,
                 headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token('pix.read')}"}, timeout=30)
if r.status_code != 200:
    erro(r)
pix = r.json()
ja = sum(float(d["valor"]) for d in pix.get("devolucoes", []) if d["status"] != "NAO_REALIZADO")
saldo = float(pix["valor"]) - ja

# 2) solicite a devolucao
r = requests.put(f"{BASE}/pix/{e2eid}/devolucao/{dev_id}",
                 json={"valor": f"{min(20.00, saldo):.2f}",
                       "descricao": "Devolucao parcial do pedido 4210"},
                 cert=CERT, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token('pix.write')}"}, timeout=30)
if r.status_code != 201:
    erro(r)
d = r.json()
print(d["id"], d["rtrId"], d["status"])   # EM_PROCESSAMENTO: confirme depois em GET

def esperar_devolucao(e2eid: str, dev_id: str, tentativas: int = 10):

import os, requests

BASE = os.environ["PIX_BASE_URL"]          # ex.: https://api.seupsp.com.br/pix/v2 (cada PSP tem a sua)
CERT = (os.environ["PIX_CERT_PEM"], os.environ["PIX_KEY_PEM"])   # mTLS obrigatorio

def token(escopo: str) -> str:
    r = requests.post(
        os.environ["PIX_TOKEN_URL"],
        data={"grant_type": "client_credentials", "scope": escopo},
        auth=(os.environ["PIX_CLIENT_ID"], os.environ["PIX_CLIENT_SECRET"]),
        cert=CERT, timeout=30,
    )
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r.json()["access_token"]

def erro(r):
    p = r.json() if "json" in r.headers.get("content-type", "") else {}
    viol = "; ".join(f'{v.get("propriedade")}: {v.get("razao")}' for v in p.get("violacoes", []))
    raise RuntimeError(f'{r.status_code} {p.get("type", "")} {p.get("detail", r.text[:200])} {viol}')

txid, data = "assinatura20260900000000000042", "2026-09-09"
r = requests.post(f"{BASE}/cobr/{txid}/retentativa/{data}", cert=CERT,
                  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token('cobr.write')}"}, timeout=30)
if r.status_code != 201:
    erro(r)   # 400 comum: politica NAO_PERMITE ou janela de 7 dias esgotada
print([t["status"] for t in r.json()["tentativas"]])
